Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid

Class BBFluidLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid.BBFluidLogic
public final class BBFluidLogic extends Object
Loader-neutral coordination of finite Big and Huge Bucket world transactions after BBItem selects a gesture. Sided block storage, arbitrary world placement, per-fluid sounds, and native powder-snow finalization are loader primitives on BucketOperations; this class applies finite-mode admission, protection, bucket debit or credit, and player observability around them.

      public static boolean canAttemptTakeAt(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack)

    • tryTakeWithContext

      public static boolean tryTakeWithContext(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, ProtectionContext context)
      Tries to take one fluid unit using an explicit player or automation context.

      A sided block store has priority and owns dispatch even when it refuses. Otherwise the world block's bucket-pickup contract is used. The exact target is protected before mutation. On a world pickup the server credits the finite bucket and emits sound and the fluid game event; player world pickup also awards the item-use statistic and filled-bucket criterion.

      Returns:
      true for an accepted client prediction or a completed server transaction

    • tryPlace

      public static boolean tryPlace(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, ProtectionContext context, boolean allowFaceOffset)
      Tries to place one fluid unit using an explicit player or automation context.

      A sided block store has priority. Otherwise placement uses the loader's arbitrary-fluid world rules; allowFaceOffset permits a blocked clicked position to resolve to its neighbor along the hit face. Protection, the finite debit, sound, and the fluid-place game event belong to the selected primitive; a successful world placement additionally awards the item-use statistic to a player.

      Returns:
      true for an accepted client prediction or a completed server transaction

    • tryPlacePowder

      public static boolean tryPlacePowder(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, ProtectionContext context, boolean allowFaceOffset)
      Tries native powder-snow placement with explicit authorization identity. Guards mode, then hands the placement to BucketOperations.placeStoredPowder(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext, boolean), which resolves the target through a loader-built BlockPlaceContext (whose constructor is loader-only), checks block-edit protection at the resolved position, runs the placement, and debits one unit with the loader's own place-event and rollback behavior.
      Returns:
      true for an accepted client prediction or a committed server placement
